title: My tasks
description: Decisions and approvals requested by running processes. “Mine” shows what you may decide; every decision is recorded in the run protocol and the audit log.
emptyMine: Nothing for you to decide right now.

panel.fourEyesHint: The person who started the run may not decide

panel.reasonRights: you need run or approve rights on this process

emptyMineText: When a running process needs your approval or decision, it shows up here and in the notification bell.
